$comment: Security findings from scanners other than npm audit and Trivy that this repository has looked at and accepted for now: Socket's alerts resolved as tolerable, and GitHub code-scanning alerts dismissed.

The rules are accepted-advisories.json's: every entry names the issue that tracks it, the reason, who decided and when, and what would end it (revisitWhen). An acceptance with no issue, or with no revisitWhen, is how a finding becomes permanent.

The monthly review (.github/workflows/accepted-risks-review.yml) opens or updates one security-health issue that lists every entry. Each one ends as gone (remove it here), still tolerable (set reviewed to that day) or now fixable (file an issue and point the entry at it).
Seeded 26 November 2026 (#3789): Socket's 7 alerts resolved as Tolerable risk (#3727), and CodeQL's #20, #25 and #26 dismissed as used in tests (#3776).
